credits: Original geometry drawn for Verdant Reach under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md). Botanical reference: Populus tremuloides and the Pando clone, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pando_(tree) . No sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. Populus tremuloides (an aspen clone such as Pando). LOOMING: a grove that is one creature, four pale trunks of different heights leaning toward the foe, fused at the base into a thick knot of glowing pale roots twisted like rope (the focal part), roots spreading off both bottom edges; their golden crowns merge into one canopy that overhangs the foe. Gesture: the roots pulse, then the trunks and canopy lean in together, hold, rebound and settle; the root knot's outline and the trunks' feet stay fixed. The aspen family's deep gold-olive dark slot under a more luminous pale green-gold mid tone (the crowns and the glow in the roots); the white bark is white plus the mid tone. Sport: a pale silver-blue winter palette, an artistic interpretation, not a cultivar.
